admission.justification: Realized across .github/workflows/quality.yml and .gitignore as part of the Phase 4 site pipeline; prevents failing Pages runs on code PRs, accidental commits of generated site/docs artifacts and broken VitePress builds slipping past CI.

applicability: CI verification in .github/workflows/quality.yml, generated-output exclusions in .gitignore and the split of public GitHub Pages publishing to ar-rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/pages.yml.
conditions: quality.yml runs site-build-check with rh-validate, rh-build-site and npm ci && npm run docs:build against a synthetic Stage 00 fixture on every PR and push to main.
.gitignore ignores site/docs/{stages,concepts,assets,public,index.md} so compiled outputs never enter Git or AR onboarding.
exclusions: Live GitHub Pages publication requires GitHub Actions to remain enabled as the Pages source on Foxfire1st/ar-rh-proof-skeleton.

evidence: Local synthetic site-build-check run (rh-validate + rh-build-site + npm run docs:build PASS)

statement: rh-proof-skeleton carries no GitHub Pages deployment workflow of its own, ignores generated site/docs outputs in .gitignore, and verifies static-site compilation and VitePress build on every PR via quality.yml site-build-check, while ar-rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/pages.yml owns public GitHub Pages deployment.
title: Dual-repo CI site-build-check, gitignored outputs and Pages deployment split
